what: all ten composition cells built twice through the real pipeline, CIRCUIT_ROUTER off and CIRCUIT_ROUTER=portfolio (the gated mode, relay/thorough). The flag's one previously measured failure was matrix-ldo-3v3__usb-c-power going fab.ready true -> false with five blocking findings; one cell is an anecdote, so this is ten.
verdict: turning the gated router on changes no board's fab.ready and adds no blocking finding. The gate declined our copper on exactly the five cells where it would have cost a net, and kept it on the five where net count held. Where kept, vias mostly fall; i2c-bus gains two, so the gate protects completeness and not quality.
